Fixed `/add-dir <subdirectory>` printing a false "couldn't be resolved" error when the working directory is on a `/net` automount
Fixed the Bedrock setup wizard hanging when AWS or an AWS credential helper never responds (it now times out with a clear error), and its model checks failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy

Fixed Remote Control uploading a session pulled with `/teleport` into the connected session, which appeared appended to the original on phone and web
Fixed Remote Control's inbound event stream failing behind TLS-inspecting corporate proxies on native Windows
Fixed Remote Control sessions showing the default effort level on claude.ai when the effort comes from settings
Fixed `gcpAuthRefresh` opening a browser at startup when the Google credential check was slow, even though the credential was still valid
Fixed claude.ai connectors staying absent for the whole session when the startup connector fetch timed out — the CLI now retries in the background
Fixed sustained high CPU usage when a background agent could not be resumed and its wake-up was retried in a tight loop
Fixed feature flags gated to a newer version occasionally applying to an older Claude Code version running on the same machine
Fixed `/usage` and the VS Code usage panel dropping a model-specific weekly limit row when the usage endpoint is rate limited or when opened right after startup
Fixed `claude -p --resume <file>` adopting a malformed session ID recorded in the transcript; it now resumes under a fresh session ID instead
Fixed the terminal progress indicator (iTerm2, Ghostty, ConEmu) showing the session as finished while a background workflow or agent was still running
Fixed a rare layout glitch where a box could render with the wrong height after its container switched between row and column direction
Fixed Claude apps gateway client IP when a trusted proxy appends a port to `X-Forwarded-For`; with an access list set, an unreadable entry now gets 403
Fixed Claude apps gateway telling Claude Desktop to export OpenTelemetry as JSON even when the terminal CLI uses protobuf, so protobuf-only collectors rejected Desktop's data
Fixed Desktop and web showing a session as busy while it only watches an artifact for updates
Fixed Claude in Chrome `file_upload` failing with "paths: expected array, received undefined" in local Cowork sessions run from the Claude Desktop app
Fixed `SendMessage` to an offline Remote Control session on another machine reading as delivered; the result now says delivery is queued until that machine reconnects
Fixed plugin install hints from CLIs run in background Bash commands: they are now detected, and the raw `<claude-code-hint>` tag no longer leaks into the conversation
Fixed in-process agent-team teammates re-sending their first-turn tool and skill announcements on the second turn, which changed the request prefix and missed the prompt cache
Improved the `/model` picker and the VS Code model pill to show a model's name instead of its raw Bedrock, Vertex AI, or LLM gateway ID when Claude Code recognizes it
Improved startup on Google Vertex AI when `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` is set: API client creation no longer re-runs Google Cloud project discovery or spawns extra `gcloud` processes
Improved streaming performance: already-rendered blocks are no longer re-checked by layout on each update
Improved the dangerous-`rm` safety prompt to also catch `rm -rf` on positional parameters and inside double-quoted `sh -c` scripts
Improved handling when the API sends no response headers: the retry now waits up to `API_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 minutes by default) instead of another 3 minutes, and the messages say what to change
Changed a Claude apps gateway 403 on the managed settings load (at startup or after `/login`) to say Claude Code may not be enabled for the organization, instead of advising a new sign-in

[VSCode] Fixed claude.ai-only features staying visible in a window's other Claude panels after one panel picked up a third-party provider from a settings file
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen appearing despite the Disable Login Prompt setting when Claude Code reports no login or a request fails for lack of one
[VSCode] Fixed the next queued permission prompt keeping text typed on the previous prompt and accepting an immediate second click
[VSCode] Fixed install-plugin links opening the Claude sidebar without the install dialog in a window where only the session list had been shown
[VSCode] Fixed the sidebar usage meter staying empty on a new window until the Account & usage dialog was opened, and a 0% usage limit being left out of the meter
[VSCode] Fixed "Start new session in this group" losing the group after New conversation, and a missing unread dot for a session that finished before the sidebar's unread list loaded
[VSCode] Fixed the editor tab badge showing unread during a running turn or missing on a tab opened from the session list, and "Add Session Tab to Group" doing nothing for an archived session
[VSCode] Fixed "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" so flipping it also applies right away to sessions open in other VS Code windows

title.zh-TW: 技能診斷指令上線，揪出閒置技能與脈絡佔用
title.en: Skill diagnostic command introduced to spot unused skills and context consumption

body.zh-TW: ⟦整理工具包就像教練定期盤點健身房器材，長期沒人碰又佔走走道的啞鈴就該清出場地。⟧ 當你為 Claude 掛載了五花八門的技能，對話脈絡（context）的容量很快就會吃緊。現在只要輸入 `/skill-doctor`，畫面就會列出目前載入的所有技能中，哪些從頭到尾都沒被呼叫過，以及它們個別佔用了多少 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）。當你發現某些擴充根本沒派上用場卻平白吃掉容量，就能依照診斷結果把它們卸載，替重要的對話釋出更多空間。
body.en: ⟦Organizing your toolkit is like a coach taking inventory of gym equipment: dumbbells that remain untouched for a long time and block the aisles should be cleared off the floor.⟧ When you load various skills into Claude, conversation context capacity can quickly become strained. Simply typing `/skill-doctor` now displays which of all currently loaded skills have never been invoked, as well as how many tokens each consumes. Once you discover extensions sitting unused while eating up capacity, you can prune them based on the diagnostic results to free up room for important conversations.

items.original: Added `/skill-doctor` to show which loaded skills go unused and what they cost in context, so you can prune them

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出上限拉高至 128K，支援由檔案讀取子代理提示詞
title.en: Command output limit raised to 128K, supporting subagent prompt loading from files

body.zh-TW:
跑大型建置或查詢長篇日誌時，終端機輸出常因超過預設長度而被截斷存成外置檔案。現在你在設定檔中加入 `bashOutputMaxChars` 或 `taskOutputMaxChars`，就能把終端機指令與背景任務直接回傳給 Claude 的內嵌字數上限拉高，最高支援到 128K 字元：
```json
{
  "bashOutputMaxChars": 131072,
  "taskOutputMaxChars": 131072
}
```
此外，當你要指派給子代理的系統提示詞（system prompt）過於龐大、無法塞進單行指令列時，也可以改用 `--append-subagent-system-prompt-file <路徑>` 直接從檔案載入。⟦這有如把貨運小貨車升級成大型貨櫃車，長篇清單不用再拆箱分裝成小紙條，整批資料都能直接載進車廂。⟧
body.en:
When running large builds or querying lengthy logs, terminal output is often truncated and saved to an external file because it exceeds the default length. Now, by adding `bashOutputMaxChars` or `taskOutputMaxChars` to your configuration file, you can raise the inline character limit for terminal commands and background tasks returned directly to Claude, supporting up to 128K characters:
```json
{
  "bashOutputMaxChars": 131072,
  "taskOutputMaxChars": 131072
}
```
Additionally, when a system prompt assigned to a subagent is too large to fit on a single command line, you can use `--append-subagent-system-prompt-file <path>` to load it directly from a file. ⟦This is like upgrading from a delivery van to a large freight container truck: instead of unboxing a long manifest into small paper slips, the entire shipment can be loaded directly into the cargo hold.⟧

items.original:
Added `bashOutputMaxChars` and `taskOutputMaxChars` settings to raise how much command and background-task output Claude receives inline before it is saved to a file, up to 128K characters
Added `--append-subagent-system-prompt-file` to read the subagent system prompt from a file, for prompts too large to pass on the command line

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入手感翻修，對齊 Bash 快捷鍵與修復漏字
title.en: Terminal input experience revamped, aligning with Bash shortcuts and fixing dropped characters

body.zh-TW: 終端機裡的文字輸入與編輯體驗迎來了一批修復。當你快速連打、長按按鍵重複輸入或是整段貼上文字時，字元不再會偶發性掉字或前後順序顛倒；而在輸入框內嵌的 `[Image #N]` 圖片標籤前，緊鄰的前一個字元現在也能順利按退格鍵刪除。同時，輸入列的單字跳轉與刪除快捷鍵全面對齊 Bash 行為：按 Ctrl+W 會往回刪除到前一個空格，Alt+F 與 Alt+D 會精準停在單字結尾，標點符號也會被視為單字分界，而舊有的 `keybindingFlavor` 設定則不再產生作用。⟦這就像換上一支書寫順暢的鋼珠筆，不管寫得多快都不會斷水卡墨，修改詞句時的橡皮擦也能精準擦到邊界。⟧
body.en: The text input and editing experience in the terminal has received a batch of fixes. Characters no longer occasionally drop or swap order when typing rapidly, holding down a key to repeat input, or pasting text blocks. The character immediately preceding an inline `[Image #N]` image chip in the input box can now also be smoothly removed using the Backspace key. Meanwhile, word navigation and deletion shortcuts in the prompt input fully align with Bash behavior: pressing Ctrl+W deletes backward to the previous whitespace, Alt+F and Alt+D stop precisely at word endings, punctuation is treated as a word boundary, and the legacy `keybindingFlavor` setting no longer has any effect. ⟦This is like switching to a smooth-writing rollerball pen that never skips or blobs no matter how fast you write, while an eraser cleanly wipes up to the boundary when modifying words.⟧

items.original:
Fixed typed or pasted characters occasionally landing out of order or being dropped during fast input or key repeat
Fixed being unable to delete the character immediately before an inline `[Image #N]` chip in the prompt input
Changed the prompt's word-editing keys to match Bash: Ctrl+W deletes back to whitespace, Alt+F and Alt+D stop at word end, punctuation separates words; `keybindingFlavor` no longer has any effect

title.zh-TW: 收緊危險刪檔防護，自動模式禁止未授權圖表上傳
title.en: Dangerous file deletion safeguards tightened, auto mode blocks unauthorized diagram uploads

body.zh-TW: ⟦把整份講義印在公開影印店的取件網址上，店員會當成講義已經送出店外；碎紙單就算寫在引號裡或用代號，也一樣要再確認才准動手。⟧ 針對高風險的刪除指令，危險 `rm` 安全提示現在擴大攔截範圍，即使 `rm -rf` 寫在雙引號包覆的 `sh -c` 腳本內，或是帶有位置參數（positional parameters，如指令後方代入的變數代號），都會確實跳出確認提示。若連結把內容打包進公開圖表繪製網站的 URL，自動模式會視為上傳到該站，除非你主動要求，否則不再自動放行。
body.en: ⟦Printing an entire handout onto the pickup URL of a public copy shop makes the clerk treat the handout as already sent outside; shredding orders must also be re-confirmed before executing, even if written inside quotes or using aliases.⟧ For high-risk deletion commands, the dangerous-`rm` safety prompt has expanded its interception scope: a confirmation prompt now reliably pops up even if `rm -rf` is inside a double-quoted `sh -c` script or involves positional parameters. If a link packages content into the URL of a public diagram rendering site, auto mode treats it as an upload to that site and will no longer auto-approve it unless you explicitly requested it.

items.original:
Improved the dangerous-`rm` safety prompt to also catch `rm -rf` on positional parameters and inside double-quoted `sh -c` scripts
Changed auto mode to treat a link that packs content into a public diagram renderer's URL as an upload to that site: no longer auto-approved unless you asked for it

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控同步修復，狀態顯示與離線佇列精準更新
title.en: Remote Control sync fixes: accurate status displays and offline queue updates

body.zh-TW: 透過手機或瀏覽器使用遠端操控（Remote Control）時，多項跨裝置狀態同步問題已全面修正。現在終端機切換權限模式，或是行動端連入終端機工作階段時，不會再顯示過期的權限狀態；從手機停止運作或執行 `/clear` 指令後，按鈕與旋轉載入圖示會即時歸位，不再卡在忙碌中。使用 `/teleport` 拉取的工作階段不會再重複附加到雲端對話紀錄，自訂的精力等級（effort level）也能正確呈現在網頁上。在 Windows 企業代理伺服器環境下的事件串流已修復，若向另一台離線機器的工作階段發送 `SendMessage`，系統也會明確告知訊息已進入佇列等候重連。⟦這有如拿著對講機指揮總部作業，雙方的狀態訊號隨時同步，發給離線人員的留言也會妥善留在收件箱中等待簽收。⟧
body.en: When using Remote Control from a phone or browser, multiple cross-device status synchronization issues have been thoroughly resolved. Switching permission modes in the terminal or attaching to a terminal session from a mobile device no longer displays a stale permission status. After stopping a run or executing a `/clear` command from a phone, buttons and loading spinners now reset immediately instead of remaining stuck in a busy state. Sessions pulled via `/teleport` are no longer redundantly appended to cloud conversation history, and custom effort levels now reflect correctly on the web. Event streaming under Windows enterprise proxy environments has been fixed, and sending `SendMessage` to a session on an offline machine now clearly informs you that the message is queued awaiting reconnection. ⟦This is like directing headquarters operations via walkie-talkie: status signals remain synchronized on both ends, while messages sent to offline personnel stay safely in their inbox waiting for acknowledgement.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control showing a stale permission mode when a phone, browser, or claude.ai app attaches to a terminal session or after the mode changes in the terminal
Fixed Remote Control sessions showing as still working (stuck spinner and Stop button) after stopping a turn from a connected phone or browser, or after a local slash command like `/clear`
Fixed Remote Control uploading a session pulled with `/teleport` into the connected session, which appeared appended to the original on phone and web
Fixed Remote Control's inbound event stream failing behind TLS-inspecting corporate proxies on native Windows
Fixed Remote Control sessions showing the default effort level on claude.ai when the effort comes from settings
Fixed `SendMessage` to an offline Remote Control session on another machine reading as delivered; the result now says delivery is queued until that machine reconnects

title.zh-TW: 企業閘道管理強化，組織政策診斷與登入規範更清楚
title.en: Enterprise gateway management enhanced with clearer organization policy diagnostics and login rules

body.zh-TW: ⟦門牌後黏了樓層號要拆出真門號；門牌讀不出來就拒收，紙本與電子改同一套格式。⟧ `/status` 與 `claude doctor` 新增組織政策行，代理攔阻政策載入失敗會標原因。受信任代理在 `X-Forwarded-For` 附加通訊埠時，閘道會修正客戶端 IP；有 access list 時無法判讀的項目回 403。閘道曾叫 Desktop 用 JSON 匯出 OpenTelemetry，CLI 用 protobuf 時只收 protobuf 的收集器會拒收 Desktop 資料，已對齊。載入受管設定遭拒時改說該組織可能未啟用服務，而非叫你重登入。`forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` 鎖定時忽略殘留 API key 或 claude.ai 登入並要求 `/login`；Bedrock、Vertex AI 與 Foundry 工作階段不受影響。
body.en: ⟦When a floor number is attached behind a house number, the true address must be parsed out; if the address is unreadable, it is rejected, while paper and electronic formats are unified into the same standard.⟧ `/status` and `claude doctor` add an Organization policy line that marks the reason when proxy blocking causes policy loading to fail. When a trusted proxy appends a port to `X-Forwarded-For`, the gateway corrects the client IP, and unreadable entries return 403 when an access list is configured. The gateway previously told Desktop to export OpenTelemetry as JSON while the CLI used protobuf, causing protobuf-only collectors to reject Desktop data; these have now been aligned. When loading managed settings is denied, the message now states that the organization may not have enabled the service instead of advising a re-login. When locked by `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"`, leftover API keys or claude.ai logins are ignored to require `/login`, while Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry sessions remain unaffected.

Fixed Claude apps gateway client IP when a trusted proxy appends a port to `X-Forwarded-For`; with an access list set, an unreadable entry now gets 403
Fixed Claude apps gateway telling Claude Desktop to export OpenTelemetry as JSON even when the terminal CLI uses protobuf, so protobuf-only collectors rejected Desktop's data
Changed a Claude apps gateway 403 on the managed settings load (at startup or after `/login`) to say Claude Code may not be enabled for the organization, instead of advising a new sign-in
Changed machines whose managed settings pin `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` to ignore a leftover API key or claude.ai login and ask for `/login`; Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry sessions are unaffected

title.zh-TW: 雲端驗證流程加速，清楚顯示模型名稱且連線不卡死
title.en: Cloud authentication accelerated, clearly displaying model names and preventing connection hangs

body.zh-TW: 設定 Bedrock 時，若 AWS 憑證（credential，證明你是合法使用者的金鑰）輔助程式無回應，引導精靈不會再無限期卡住，而是會在逾時後印出明確錯誤，並修正了在安全檢驗代理伺服器後的檢查失敗。`gcpAuthRefresh` 在憑證仍有效、只是檢查稍慢時，不會再於啟動時打開瀏覽器；設定 `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` 也不會再反覆搜尋專案或啟動額外行程。啟動時抓 claude.ai 連接器若逾時，整個工作階段都會看不見它們，CLI 改在背景重試。`/model` 選單與 VS Code 模型膠囊在辨識得出時，會顯示名稱而非 Bedrock、Vertex AI 或 LLM gateway 的原始 ID。⟦這好比拿著跨國貴賓卡登機，櫃台能直接辨識你的身分並快速放行，遇到連線延遲也會在後台自動補驗，不必每次都把你叫去重辦手續。⟧
body.en: During Bedrock setup, if an AWS credential helper fails to respond, the setup wizard no longer hangs indefinitely but prints a clear error upon timeout, while also fixing check failures behind TLS-inspecting proxies. `gcpAuthRefresh` no longer opens a browser at startup when Google credentials are still valid but checks are slightly slow, and configuring `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` avoids repeatedly searching for projects or spawning extra processes. When fetching claude.ai connectors at startup times out, which previously made them invisible for the entire session, the CLI now retries in the background. The `/model` picker and VS Code model pill now display recognizable model names instead of raw Bedrock, Vertex AI, or LLM gateway IDs when identified. ⟦This is like boarding with an international VIP card: the counter immediately recognizes your identity for quick clearance, while background verification runs automatically during connection delays instead of repeatedly calling you over to reapply.⟧

Fixed `gcpAuthRefresh` opening a browser at startup when the Google credential check was slow, even though the credential was still valid
Fixed claude.ai connectors staying absent for the whole session when the startup connector fetch timed out — the CLI now retries in the background

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復不掉訊，多代理協作快取與外掛同步修復
title.en: Session resume preserves context, fixing multi-agent collaboration cache and plugin syncing

body.zh-TW: 中斷後重新接續工作階段時，系統現在能更忠實還原當時的上下文。以前恢復工作階段時，平行工具呼叫旁的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）輸出常會遺失，現在已能完整保留；使用 `claude -p --resume` 若遇到紀錄檔內的工作階段識別碼損壞，也會自動配發新識別碼安全重啟。在多代理協作中，隊友代理在第二輪不會再重複廣播初始技能，確保前綴完整並命中快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）；背景代理若無法喚醒，也不會再陷入迴圈空轉消耗 CPU。此外，剛送出提示詞立刻按下停止現在能確實中斷執行，雲端工作階段強制啟用已同步的外掛時，也不會再錯誤降級至市集備援版本。⟦這就像接力賽交棒，跑者換人時能精準接過寫滿備忘的交接棒，不用重新宣告身分，遇到突發狀況也能立刻煞車。⟧
body.en: When resuming an interrupted session, the system now more faithfully restores the context from that point. Previously, hook outputs around parallel tool calls were often lost when resuming a session, but they are now fully preserved. Running `claude -p --resume` with a corrupted session ID in the transcript will automatically assign a fresh session ID for a safe restart. In multi-agent collaboration, teammate agents no longer re-broadcast initial skills on the second turn, ensuring prefix integrity and hitting the cache. If a background agent fails to wake up, it no longer enters a tight loop burning CPU. Furthermore, clicking stop right after sending a prompt now reliably halts execution, and cloud sessions force-enabling synced plugins will no longer erroneously fall back to marketplace clones. ⟦This is like passing the baton in a relay race: the next runner smoothly takes the note-covered baton without re-announcing their identity, and can brake immediately if an unexpected event occurs.⟧

items.original:
Fixed resuming a session losing hook output and other context around parallel tool calls, which changed the resumed request
Fixed `claude -p --resume <file>` adopting a malformed session ID recorded in the transcript; it now resumes under a fresh session ID instead
Fixed SDK and cloud sessions ignoring a Stop or interrupt sent just after the first prompt, before the turn had started; the turn now stops instead of running to completion
Fixed sustained high CPU usage when a background agent could not be resumed and its wake-up was retried in a tight loop
Fixed in-process agent-team teammates re-sending their first-turn tool and skill announcements on the second turn, which changed the request prefix and missed the prompt cache
Fixed cloud sessions discarding a plugin synced from claude.ai when managed settings force-enable it in `enabledPlugins`, then falling back to a marketplace clone that could fail

title.zh-TW: 終端機進度指示精準回報，文字串流加速且計量不浪費
title.en: Terminal progress indicator reports accurately, accelerating text streaming and avoiding wasted metering

body.zh-TW: ⟦月台資訊看板在列車還在進站時不能亮「已離站」，轉乘等候的倒數也要跟公告上限同一套，不能自己再加一輪。⟧ 在 iTerm2、Ghostty 或 ConEmu 等終端機中，進度指示器以前會在背景工作流程或代理仍在運作時提早把工作階段標記為完成，現在已修正為如實反映背景狀態。文字串流輸出時，排版引擎不再對已繪製完成的區塊重複運算，大幅提升了長篇回覆的顯示流暢度，也修復了容器方向切換時區塊高度異常的罕見錯誤。當你執行 `/context` 查看容量，若遠端計量服務無法連線，系統會改用本機演算法估算 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），不再額外呼叫小型模型浪費資源。遇到 API 無回應標頭時，重試會等到 `API_TIMEOUT_MS`（預設 10 分鐘）為止，不再另等 3 分鐘，提示訊息會說明可改 `API_TIMEOUT_MS`。
body.en: ⟦A platform information board must not display "Departed" while the train is still pulling into the station, and transfer wait countdowns must follow the posted ceiling rather than adding an extra round on their own.⟧ In terminals like iTerm2, Ghostty, or ConEmu, the progress indicator previously marked sessions as finished prematurely while background workflows or agents were still running; it has now been fixed to faithfully reflect background status. During text streaming, the layout engine no longer recalculates already-rendered blocks, significantly improving rendering smoothness for long responses and fixing a rare glitch where block height corrupted when containers switched directions. When running `/context` to check capacity, if the remote token-counting API is unavailable, the system switches to local estimation instead of making extra small-model requests. When the API sends no response headers, retries wait up to `API_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 minutes by default) instead of adding another 3 minutes, with messages explaining that `API_TIMEOUT_MS` can be adjusted.

items.original:
Fixed the terminal progress indicator (iTerm2, Ghostty, ConEmu) showing the session as finished while a background workflow or agent was still running
Fixed a rare layout glitch where a box could render with the wrong height after its container switched between row and column direction
Improved streaming performance: already-rendered blocks are no longer re-checked by layout on each update
Improved handling when the API sends no response headers: the retry now waits up to `API_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 minutes by default) instead of another 3 minutes, and the messages say what to change
Changed `/context` token counting to use a local estimate when the token-counting API is unavailable, instead of extra small-model requests

title.zh-TW: 跨工具協作修復，自動掛載目錄與用量查詢更穩定
title.en: Cross-tool collaboration fixes: automount directory handling and usage queries stabilized

body.zh-TW: 掛載在 `/net` automount 網路目錄下執行 `/add-dir` 加入子資料夾時，系統不再會誤報找不到路徑；當同一台電腦安裝多個版本時，高版本的功能旗標也不會再錯誤干擾舊版本。當用量端點被限流，或剛啟動就打開時，`/usage` 與 VS Code 用量面板不再丟掉特定模型的每週額度列。桌面版與網頁版在僅監聽產物（artifact）更新時，狀態也不會再錯誤卡在忙碌中。此外，桌面版 Cowork 工作階段中透過 Chrome 擴充上傳檔案的錯誤已排除，背景執行的指令若輸出外掛安裝提示，也能正確被系統辨識，不會把原始的 `<claude-code-hint>` 標籤洩漏到對話框裡。⟦這宛如在多工工地整頓各組機具，圖紙路徑標註清晰，讓不同的協作工具各司其職且不互相打架。⟧
body.en: When running `/add-dir` to add a subdirectory while mounted under a `/net` automount directory, the system no longer falsely reports that the path could not be resolved. On machines with multiple versions installed, feature flags gated to newer versions no longer mistakenly affect older versions. When the usage endpoint is rate-limited or accessed immediately after startup, `/usage` and the VS Code usage panel no longer drop weekly limit rows for specific models. Desktop and web sessions no longer stay incorrectly busy when only watching artifacts for updates. In addition, file upload failures via the Chrome extension in Desktop Cowork sessions have been resolved, and plugin install hints output by background commands are now properly recognized without leaking raw `<claude-code-hint>` tags into the conversation. ⟦This is like organizing equipment across a multi-trade construction site: blueprints and pathways are clearly marked so that different collaborating tools work in harmony without clashing.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/add-dir <subdirectory>` printing a false "couldn't be resolved" error when the working directory is on a `/net` automount
Fixed feature flags gated to a newer version occasionally applying to an older Claude Code version running on the same machine
Fixed `/usage` and the VS Code usage panel dropping a model-specific weekly limit row when the usage endpoint is rate limited or when opened right after startup
Fixed Desktop and web showing a session as busy while it only watches an artifact for updates
Fixed Claude in Chrome `file_upload` failing with "paths: expected array, received undefined" in local Cowork sessions run from the Claude Desktop app
Fixed plugin install hints from CLIs run in background Bash commands: they are now detected, and the raw `<claude-code-hint>` tag no longer leaks into the conversation

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 介面內建樣式精靈，直接新增與管理 MCP 伺服器
title.en: [VSCode] Built-in style walkthrough added, directly create and manage MCP servers

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 擴充套件中自訂輸出風格與工具整合變得更加直覺。Output styles 選單新增了「建立自訂樣式」引導流程，能帶你一步步撰寫自訂輸出樣式檔，完成後立刻列在選單中隨選即用。針對 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器管理，對話框中現在直接提供了新增表單與刪除按鈕，你再也不用手動切出編輯器去修改設定檔，就能在介面內隨時加入或卸載各類外部工具伺服器。⟦這如同在畫架旁直接加裝模組化置物盒，想換筆刷或顏料伸手就能裝上，不必每次都離開座位去工具箱翻找。⟧
body.en: Customizing output styles and tool integrations in the VS Code extension has become much more intuitive. The Output styles menu adds a "Build a custom style" walkthrough that guides you step-by-step to write a custom output style file and lists it immediately for instant use. For MCP server management, the dialog now provides an Add server form and Remove button directly, allowing you to add or remove external tool servers inside the IDE without manually switching out to edit configuration files. ⟦This is like attaching a modular organizer right beside your easel: whenever you want to swap brushes or paints, you can reach out and attach them without leaving your seat to rummage through a toolbox.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a "Build a custom style" walkthrough to the Output styles menu that writes a custom output style file and lists it right away
[VSCode] Added an Add server form and a Remove action to the MCP servers dialog, so MCP servers can be added and removed without leaving the IDE

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 工作階段清單標示強化，支援封存與分頁修復
title.en: [VSCode] Session list indicators enhanced, supporting archiving and tab fixes

body.zh-TW: ⟦管理多個工作階段就像整理辦公室公文夾，哪些案件正在其他部門借閱中、哪些該歸檔，都該有清楚的視覺標記。⟧ 工作階段清單現在為終端機、其他視窗或桌面版開啟中的工作階段標上空心圓圈，不再看起來像已關閉；右鍵選單加入了「封存工作階段」（Archive session）功能，解除封存也有了專屬圖示。隨視窗還原的分頁在重新命名時，輸入框會正確帶出當前名稱而非一片空白；清單中已摺疊的分類在面板載入時不會再短暫閃爍展開，修正背景分頁識別碼時選取列的高亮也不會卡死。透過快速鍵或連結重新開啟分頁時，Claude 分頁也會精準回到既有的編輯器分組中。
body.en: ⟦Managing multiple sessions is like organizing office folders: which cases are currently on loan to other departments and which should be archived must have clear visual markers.⟧ The session list now marks sessions open in a terminal, another window, or Claude Desktop with a hollow ring so they no longer appear closed. The right-click menu adds "Archive session", while Unarchive gets its own icon. When renaming a tab restored with the window, the input box correctly populates with the current name instead of opening blank. Collapsed sections in the list no longer briefly flash expanded when the panel loads, and the active-row highlight no longer freezes when correcting an unfocused tab's session ID. Reopening tabs via shortcuts or links now accurately places Claude tabs back into their existing editor group.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a hollow ring in the session list for sessions open in a terminal, another VS Code window, or Claude Desktop, so they no longer look closed
[VSCode] Added "Archive session" to the session list's right-click menu and gave Unarchive its own icon
[VSCode] Fixed the session tab's Rename box opening empty for a tab restored with the window; it now starts with the current name
[VSCode] Fixed collapsed sections in the session list panel briefly showing expanded each time the panel loaded
[VSCode] Fixed the session list's active-row highlight going stale when an unfocused Claude tab's session ID is corrected
[VSCode] Fixed Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T reopen and deep-link opens placing the Claude tab outside the Claude editor group when a Claude tab has focus

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 提問與授權提示支援摺疊，排隊對話框不再殘留文字
title.en: [VSCode] Question and permission prompts support folding, queued dialogs no longer retain text

body.zh-TW: 互動介面上的各類提示卡片迎來了更流暢的操作體驗。權限與提問對話框現在新增了摺疊按鈕，讓你不用關閉提示就能瀏覽後方遮住的對話內容，提示旁的空白區域也能直接滾動對話歷史。連續排隊的授權對話框不會再殘留上一個提示打進去的文字，也避免了因連點而誤觸授權；焦點檢視（Focus view）中已結束的工具呼叫不再錯誤顯示為執行中。以 Claude.ai 或主控台（Console）帳號登入時，重載面板後等待回答的問題卡片會正常重現；使用 `/btw` 插話提問時，先前工作階段的歷史紀錄也不會再因視窗重載或設定檔出錯而被洗掉。⟦這如同在服務櫃台前加裝透明活動板，既能隨時掀開查看底下的文件明細，叫號處理業務時也不會把上一位顧客留下的便條紙混進下一張表單。⟧
body.en: Interactive prompt cards now offer a smoother operational experience. Permission and question prompts add a fold button so you can view underlying conversation content without dismissing the prompt, while the blank space beside the prompt can directly scroll conversation history. Successive queued permission dialogs no longer retain text typed into the previous prompt, preventing accidental approvals from rapid double-clicking. Completed tool calls in Focus view no longer mistakenly show as running. When signed in with a Claude.ai or Console account, pending question cards reappear properly after reloading the panel. When asking side questions with `/btw`, previous session history is no longer overwritten by window reloads or configuration errors. ⟦This is like installing a transparent movable flap at a service counter: you can lift it anytime to inspect document details underneath, and calling the next ticket will not mix notes left by the previous customer into the next form.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a fold button to permission and question prompts so the conversation behind them can be read without dismissing them; the space beside the prompt now scrolls the conversation
[VSCode] Fixed Focus view showing a tool call as still running after Claude had moved on, such as while a question waited for your answer
[VSCode] Fixed the next queued permission prompt keeping text typed on the previous prompt and accepting an immediate second click
[VSCode] Fixed `/btw` side-question history from earlier sessions being overwritten when a question is asked right after a window reload or while a settings file has errors
[VSCode] Fixed the pending question card not reappearing after the Claude panel reloads when signed in with a Claude.ai or Console account

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 雲端工作階段遷移修復，分組與多視窗同步更穩定
title.en: [VSCode] Cloud session migration fixes: grouping and multi-window sync stabilized

body.zh-TW: ⟦跨裝置切換開發環境就像在不同會議室之間移動白板，任何未完的討論都該原樣帶入新空間。⟧ 從網頁版傳送（teleport）工作階段至本機時，若雲端關閉時恰好有提問中斷，系統不會再將其誤判為拒絕；將網頁工作階段加入分組時，也不會再同時出現在兩個群組中。清單開的分頁重載後不跳回舊工作階段；Web 開的分頁重載後不重跑 teleport、不留白。設定「Enable Remote Control for all sessions」會立刻套用到其他 VS Code 視窗。Open 篩選器能對上從 claude.ai 續接、分頁仍記在 web session 的項目，篩選選單區塊加上螢幕報讀標籤。「Start new session in this group」在 New conversation 後不再丟掉群組；sidebar 未讀清單載入前就結束的工作階段，不再缺未讀點。
body.en: ⟦Switching development environments across devices is like moving a whiteboard between conference rooms: any unfinished discussion should be brought intact into the new space.⟧ When teleporting a session from the web to a local machine, questions interrupted as the cloud session shuts down are no longer misinterpreted as declined. Adding a web session to a group will no longer cause it to appear in two groups simultaneously. Tabs opened from the list do not jump back to older sessions after reloading, while tabs opened from web sessions do not re-run teleport or stay blank after reloads. Setting "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" applies immediately to other VS Code windows. The Open filter properly matches items continued from claude.ai whose tabs remain recorded under web sessions, with filter menu sections labeled for screen readers. "Start new session in this group" no longer loses its group after New conversation, and sessions ending before the sidebar unread list loads no longer miss their unread dot.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a session teleported from Claude Code on the web treating a question that was cut off when the cloud session shut down as declined
[VSCode] Fixed the session tab's "Add to group" putting a session opened from Claude Code on the Web in two groups; it now moves the entry the session list shows
[VSCode] Fixed a tab opened from the session list jumping back to that session, and a tab opened from a Web session restarting its teleport or staying empty, after VS Code reloads the tab's view
[VSCode] Fixed "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" so flipping it also applies right away to sessions open in other VS Code windows
[VSCode] Fixed the session list's Open filter for sessions continued from claude.ai whose tab was still recorded under the web session, and labeled the filter menu's sections for screen readers
[VSCode] Fixed "Start new session in this group" losing the group after New conversation, and a missing unread dot for a session that finished before the sidebar's unread list loaded

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 模型選單整併為單一清單，用量指示與登入防護修復
title.en: [VSCode] Model menu consolidated into flat list, usage indicators and login guards fixed

body.zh-TW: 模型選擇器與側邊欄狀態管理在此次更新中進行了整頓。模型選單現在改為平整的單一清單，舊有名稱寫法統一排在最後，且能即時隱藏公司已停用的模型。若設定了停用登入提示，介面就不會再於未登入時強行跳出登入畫面；當某個面板切換至第三方模型供應商時，其他面板也不會再殘留官方專屬功能。新視窗側邊欄的用量計量表現在一開就能正常顯示，不再漏掉零用量上限；此外外掛安裝連結能正確喚起確認對話框，分頁標籤在執行中不會再誤亮未讀徽章，封存的工作階段也能順利加入分組。⟦這好比餐廳重新整理總菜單，下架品項一目了然，服務生也不會拿著舊通行證向已免檢的客人反覆查驗身分。⟧
body.en: The model picker and sidebar state management have been overhauled in this update. The model menu is now a flat single list where legacy spellings are placed last, while immediately hiding models disabled by an organization. If the Disable Login Prompt setting is enabled, the interface no longer forces a sign-in screen when not logged in. When one panel switches to a third-party model provider, other panels no longer retain official-only features. The sidebar usage meter in a new window renders properly right upon opening without missing a 0% usage limit. Furthermore, plugin install links correctly trigger confirmation dialogs, tab badges no longer mistakenly illuminate unread during a running turn, and archived sessions can be successfully added to groups. ⟦This is like a restaurant reorganizing its master menu: discontinued items are clear at a glance, and servers will not repeatedly challenge exempt guests using outdated access passes.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the model picker showing models an organization has since disabled until the window was reloaded twice
[VSCode] Fixed claude.ai-only features staying visible in a window's other Claude panels after one panel picked up a third-party provider from a settings file
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen appearing despite the Disable Login Prompt setting when Claude Code reports no login or a request fails for lack of one
[VSCode] Fixed install-plugin links opening the Claude sidebar without the install dialog in a window where only the session list had been shown
[VSCode] Fixed the sidebar usage meter staying empty on a new window until the Account & usage dialog was opened, and a 0% usage limit being left out of the meter
[VSCode] Fixed the editor tab badge showing unread during a running turn or missing on a tab opened from the session list, and "Add Session Tab to Group" doing nothing for an archived session
[VSCode] Changed the model picker to one flat list of every model, with rows kept for older model spellings listed last

title.zh-TW: Astra 現身內建模型挑選器，未明確設定時成為預設選項
title.en: Astra now visible in the bundled model picker, becomes default when unconfigured

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟 Codex 準備寫程式時，如果沒有在設定中明確指定特定模型，現在會直接以 Astra 作為內建預設模型。過去 Astra 在內建的模型挑選器（供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）中可能無法正常看見，這次更新修復了顯示問題，讓它清楚出現在挑選清單供你點選；只要你未額外指定其他模型，它就會自動接手你的開發工作。⟦這就像走進專業工作間，出廠預設直接由全能技師接手派工，工具牆上的值班清單也正式掛出他的名牌，即使進門前沒特別指定師傅，也能直接享有標準服務。⟧這讓尚未配置偏好模型的日常操作能直接使用 Astra ，切換時也能在清單中快速找到。
body.en: When you open Codex to start coding, if no specific model is explicitly configured, Astra now serves directly as the bundled default model. Previously, Astra could fail to appear properly in the bundled model picker (a menu for switching between different AI versions); this update fixes the visibility issue, so it now shows up clearly in the selection list for you to pick; as long as you haven't specified another model, it automatically takes over your development work. ⟦It's like walking into a professional workshop where, by factory default, an all-around technician takes over your job assignment, and their name is now properly posted on the duty roster on the tool wall—even if you didn't specify a technician before walking in, you still get standard service right away.⟧ This lets everyday operations without a configured preferred model use Astra directly, and it can also be found quickly in the list when switching.

items.original: Fixed Astra’s visibility in the bundled model picker and made it the bundled default when no model is explicitly configured. (#42874)

title.zh-TW: Astra 調整非同步提問指引，僅在工作階段提供工具時發問
title.en: Astra's async-question guidance updated to ask only when the session provides the tool

body.zh-TW: 交給 Astra 處理複雜任務時，它在背景發問確認的行為現在更精準。這次更新調整了 Astra 的內建指引，明確限制它只有在目前工作階段確實具備提問工具時，才能向你發起非同步提問（在背景等候回覆、不卡住手邊工作的發問機制）。以前若環境未提供相應工具，模型可能仍會嘗試發送背景問題；現在有了這層條件約束，提問動作只會在支援的環境下觸發。⟦這如同野外巡邏隊員在遇到狀況時，會先檢查隨身裝備是否配有無線電對講機，只有在通訊器材完備時才向總部回傳發問，不會對著沒有訊號的空耳機呼叫。⟧如此一來，工作階段在缺乏提問模組時能維持穩定運行，不會被不合時宜的發問中斷。
body.en: When you hand Astra a complex task, its behavior of asking background confirmation questions is now more precise. This update adjusts Astra's built-in guidance, explicitly restricting it to initiate asynchronous questions to you (a mechanism that waits for a reply in the background without blocking your current work) only when the tool for questions is actually available in the current session. Previously, if the environment didn't provide the corresponding tool, the model could still attempt to send background questions; now with this condition in place, the questioning action only triggers in a supported environment. ⟦This is like a field patrol officer who, upon encountering a situation, first checks whether their gear includes a radio—only reporting back to headquarters with questions when the communication equipment is in place, rather than calling into a signal-less, empty headset.⟧ As a result, the session can keep running stably even when the questioning module is unavailable, without being interrupted by an ill-timed question.

items.original: Updated Astra’s guidance to use asynchronous questions only when the tool is available in the session. (#42878)

entries: Added `/model <name> <prompt>`, which runs a single prompt on another model and then returns the session to the model it was using, so you can consult a different model mid-conversation without disturbing your saved default.
Added a `conversation_title` field to the JSON payload passed to custom status line and window title scripts, so they can show the active conversation's name and pick up renames immediately.

Added an `agents` list to custom agent Markdown frontmatter, letting an agent declare the subagents it depends on using the same workspace-relative, absolute, and agent-relative path rules as `skills`.
Improved `/model` to show a `[model]` argument hint as you type, so the command's arguments are discoverable without opening help.

Improved the `/settings` panel so each Verbosity option explains itself as you highlight it, describing whether tool calls, commands, and thoughts are shown in full or collapsed into a token metrics table.

Improved the sign-in and Google Cloud setup screens to use the CLI's standard styled key hints, which follow your color scheme and keybindings and drop the navigation hint when only one option is available.
Changed `/model <name>` to report `Model already set to <name>` when the session is already using that model, instead of reporting a switch that did not happen.
Fixed tool calls to MCP servers accepting arguments the server's own schema never declared, so an invented parameter is now rejected and corrected instead of being silently dropped.

Fixed headless runs with `-p` silently skipping tool actions they were not permitted to take, which now end with a notice naming the refused actions and report them as `denied_actions` in the JSON output.

Fixed `?` in Vim Normal mode opening the shortcuts panel while the prompt already contained text, so character-search and replace operators such as `f?`, `t?`, and `df?` work; `?` still opens shortcuts on an empty prompt.
Fixed `/model` with no argument doing nothing when run before the session had finished starting up, so it now opens the model picker.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) exiting before the session finished shutting down, which could drop the run's trailing conversation history before it reached disk.
Fixed a redundant approval prompt when the agent reads or writes another conversation's artifact files after you have already allowed access to files outside your workspace.

title.zh-TW: `/model` 支援單次提問切換，輸入提示與啟動選單全面修正
title.en: `/model` Supports Single-Prompt Model Switching with Comprehensive Fixes to Input Hints and Startup Menus

body.zh-TW: 對話進行到一半想換個模型問一句話，現在不必更改整體設定。⟦像向主治醫師看診時，中途請隔壁專科專家進診間單獨看一張片子，問完立即回到主治醫師，不必重新辦理轉院手續。⟧新指令 `/model <name> <prompt>` 讓你用另一個模型跑單次提問，結束後工作階段（你與 AI 進行對話的一段連線）自動切回原本模型，完全不影響已儲存的預設值。寫完程式想打 `/model gemini-3.8-flash 檢查資安漏洞` 諮詢其他觀點，這正是使用時機。此外，輸入 `/model` 時會即時浮現 `[model]` 參數提示，不開求助說明也能知道用法。若工作階段已在該模型，指令改為回報 `Model already set to <name>` 而非誤報切換。在工作階段啟動完成前輸入不帶參數的 `/model`，現在也會正常開啟模型挑選器。
body.en: You no longer need to change your global settings when you want to switch models for a single question mid-conversation. ⟦It is like consulting your primary physician and having a specialist step into the examination room just to review a single scan, immediately returning to your primary physician once done without undergoing hospital transfer procedures.⟧ The new `/model <name> <prompt>` command lets you run a single prompt on another model, automatically returning the session to its original model afterward without affecting your saved defaults. If you finish writing code and want to run `/model gemini-3.8-flash 檢查資安漏洞` to consult another perspective, this is the exact use case. In addition, typing `/model` now displays a real-time `[model]` argument hint so you know how to use it without opening help. If the session is already using that model, the command now reports `Model already set to <name>` instead of falsely reporting a switch. Running `/model` without arguments before the session finishes starting up also now properly opens the model picker.

items.original:
Added `/model <name> <prompt>`, which runs a single prompt on another model and then returns the session to the model it was using, so you can consult a different model mid-conversation without disturbing your saved default.
Improved `/model` to show a `[model]` argument hint as you type, so the command's arguments are discoverable without opening help.
Changed `/model <name>` to report `Model already set to <name>` when the session is already using that model, instead of reporting a switch that did not happen.
Fixed `/model` with no argument doing nothing when run before the session had finished starting up, so it now opens the model picker.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 自訂代理支援 `agents` 清單，直接宣告相依子代理路徑
title.en: Custom Markdown Agents Support `agents` List to Directly Declare Dependent Subagent Paths

body.zh-TW:
替專案設計多代理協作時，自訂代理現在能直接宣告自己專屬的下層幫手。在定義代理的 Markdown 檔案開頭，檔案標頭（frontmatter，用三條橫線包夾的設定區塊）新增了 `agents` 清單。你可以直接列出該代理依賴的各個子代理，並完全比照 `skills` 技能的定位方式，自由使用工作區相對路徑、絕對路徑或代理相對路徑：

```
---
agents:
  - ./researcher.md       # 代理相對路徑
  - subagents/verifier.md # 工作區相對路徑
  - /global/audit.md      # 絕對路徑
---
```

當你撰寫一份資安稽核代理，希望它自動叫出專門查閱程式碼的輔助幫手，只要在定義檔開頭寫好這份清單，系統就會精準載入依賴項目。⟦好比主廚在宴席菜單頂端註明各道菜餚專屬的備料助手與冷盤學徒，後廚依名冊在開工前配齊人手，不必等客人入座後才手忙腳亂到處調派支援。⟧
body.en:
When designing multi-agent collaboration for a project, custom agents can now directly declare their own subordinate helpers. The Markdown frontmatter at the beginning of an agent definition file has added an `agents` list. You can directly list the subagents this agent depends on, using workspace-relative paths, absolute paths, or agent-relative paths just like `skills`:

```
---
agents:
  - ./researcher.md       # Agent-relative path
  - subagents/verifier.md # Workspace-relative path
  - /global/audit.md      # Absolute path
---
```

When creating a security audit agent that needs to automatically invoke a dedicated code inspection helper, simply declaring this list at the top of the definition file ensures the system accurately loads the dependencies. ⟦Like a head chef listing dedicated prep assistants and cold-dish apprentices at the top of a banquet menu so the kitchen can staff up before work begins, rather than scrambling to dispatch helpers after guests are seated.⟧

items.original: Added an `agents` list to custom agent Markdown frontmatter, letting an agent declare the subagents it depends on using the same workspace-relative, absolute, and agent-relative path rules as `skills`.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列與視窗標題腳本新增 `conversation_title`，即時同步對話重新命名
title.en: Status Line and Window Title Scripts Add `conversation_title` to Synchronize Renamed Conversations in Real Time

body.zh-TW:
想要在螢幕邊界隨時掌握當前對話，自訂腳本現在能取得更豐富的資訊。⟦如同會議室門口掛著的數位名牌，只要發起人更改專案名稱，螢幕隨即同步換上新標題，讓走進門的人一目了然。⟧傳遞給自訂狀態列（終端機最底下的即時資訊列）與視窗標題腳本的 JSON 酬載中，新增了 `conversation_title` 欄位。你的腳本可以直接讀取該欄位來顯示當前進行中的對話名稱，即使中途為對話重新命名，介面也能立即跟進最新標題，不再停留在舊名稱或預設代號：

```
{
  "conversation_title": "重構登入模組"
}
```

當你同時開啟多個終端機視窗處理不同專案，只要腳本讀取這個新欄位，就能清楚辨認每個視窗正在進行的任務主題。
body.en:
Custom scripts can now retrieve richer information to help you track active conversations at the screen edge at any time. ⟦Like a digital nameplate outside a conference room that instantly updates when the organizer renames the project, giving anyone walking in immediate clarity.⟧ The JSON payload passed to custom status line and window title scripts now includes a `conversation_title` field. Your scripts can directly read this field to display the active conversation's name, picking up renames immediately rather than staying stuck on old names or default identifiers:

```
{
  "conversation_title": "Refactor login module"
}
```

When running multiple terminal windows across different projects, having your script read this new field makes it easy to identify the task topic in each window.

items.original: Added a `conversation_title` field to the JSON payload passed to custom status line and window title scripts, so they can show the active conversation's name and pick up renames immediately.

title.zh-TW: 無頭與列印模式 `-p` 執行加固，未授權動作明確列出且紀錄完整落盤
title.en: Hardened Execution for Headless and Print Mode `-p`: Unauthorized Actions Explicitly Listed and Records Flushed to Disk

body.zh-TW: 把 AI 放入自動化排程背景執行，最怕工具被拒絕時毫無動靜、或者紀錄沒寫完就中途斷線。⟦宛如派出全自動無人採樣車，遇到未經授權的管制區域時不再裝作沒事直接略過，而是在日誌中白紙黑字寫明被拒絕的地點，且返航時一定等所有檢測數據完整寫入隨身碟才關閉電源。⟧以 `-p` 參數跑 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）時，過去系統若遇到未獲授權的工具動作，會默默跳過不執行；現在程式結束時會明確列出被拒絕的動作名稱，並在 JSON 輸出中標記為 `denied_actions`。此外，列印模式以前在工作階段尚未完成關閉前就過早退出，容易導致末尾的對話歷史紀錄還沒寫入磁碟就被丟棄；現在會確實等待工作階段完整落盤後才退出。
body.en: When running AI in background automated schedules, the worst issues are silent tool rejections or dropped records due to premature disconnections. ⟦Like an autonomous sampling rover that, when encountering an unauthorized restricted zone, no longer skips past it silently but clearly logs the refused location in writing, and always waits for all telemetry to flush to storage before powering off on its return.⟧ When running headless with `-p`, the system previously skipped unauthorized tool actions silently; it now ends with a notice naming the refused actions and reports them as `denied_actions` in the JSON output. In addition, print mode previously exited before the session finished shutting down, which could drop trailing conversation history before it reached disk; it now properly waits for the session to finish writing to disk before exiting.

items.original:
Fixed headless runs with `-p` silently skipping tool actions they were not permitted to take, which now end with a notice naming the refused actions and report them as `denied_actions` in the JSON output.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) exiting before the session finished shutting down, which could drop the run's trailing conversation history before it reached disk.

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具呼叫嚴格核對規格，虛構參數主動拒絕並修正
title.en: MCP Tool Calls Strictly Validate Schemas, Actively Rejecting and Correcting Invented Parameters

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 連接外部伺服器執行專屬工具，傳入參數的檢驗標準現在變得更加嚴密。過去呼叫 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，如果 AI 自行虛構了該伺服器規格架構中從未宣告過的額外參數，舊版系統往往會默默丟棄這些多餘參數而不提示，導致呼叫行為偏離預期。現在底層驗證機制已修正，遇到規格外的虛構參數會主動予以拒絕並要求修正，確保每次工具呼叫都嚴格符合定義。⟦這就像去銀行臨櫃填寫匯款單，如果填表人自作主張在空白處多勾選了規格從未印製的自創項目，櫃員不會裝作沒看見直接劃掉，而是會當場退單並指引你填寫合規欄位。⟧
body.en: Validation standards for passing arguments have become much stricter when connecting AI to external servers for dedicated tools. When calling MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers in the past, if the AI invented extra arguments never declared in the server's schema, the system often silently dropped them without notice, causing unexpected behavior. The underlying validation mechanism is now fixed to actively reject and correct invented parameters outside the schema, ensuring every tool call strictly matches definitions. ⟦Like filling out a bank transfer slip where, if the applicant checks custom options never printed on the form, the teller will not silently cross them out, but will reject the slip on the spot and guide you to fill out valid fields.⟧

items.original: Fixed tool calls to MCP servers accepting arguments the server's own schema never declared, so an invented parameter is now rejected and corrected instead of being silently dropped.

title.zh-TW: 設定面板詳述輸出詳細度，初始引導畫面按鍵提示全面標準化
title.en: Settings Panel Details Verbosity Levels, and Onboarding Key Hints Are Fully Standardized

body.zh-TW: 在終端機調整設定或初次登入時，畫面引導變得更加貼合你的使用習慣。⟦在科技展廳的觸控機台前瀏覽時，每當手勢移到不同選項，旁邊的動態看板就會詳細解釋功能差異，且按鈕背光會自動配合展廳色調，遇到單一通道時更會主動收起多餘的方向提示。⟧開啟 `/settings` 設定面板時，游標移到各個 Verbosity 詳細度選項上，畫面會即時展開說明文字。它會詳細描述工具呼叫、終端指令與思考推導是完整展開顯示，還是濃縮進 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計量表中。此外，帳號登入與 Google Cloud 設定引導畫面全面改用命令列標準樣式的按鍵提示，能完全跟隨你的終端配色與自訂鍵位綁定，當畫面上只有單一選項可選時，系統也會主動隱藏多餘的方向導覽提示。
body.en: On-screen guidance fits your habits much better when tweaking settings in the terminal or logging in for the first time. ⟦Like browsing a touchscreen kiosk in a tech showroom where highlighting different options prompts a dynamic billboard to explain functional differences, button backlights adapt to showroom colors, and navigation arrows hide when only a single path exists.⟧ When opening the `/settings` panel, highlighting each Verbosity option now expands explanatory text in real time. It describes in detail whether tool calls, terminal commands, and thoughts are shown in full or collapsed into a token metrics table. In addition, sign-in and Google Cloud setup screens now use standard styled CLI key hints that follow your terminal color scheme and custom keybindings, dropping navigation hints when only one option is available.

items.original:
Improved the `/settings` panel so each Verbosity option explains itself as you highlight it, describing whether tool calls, commands, and thoughts are shown in full or collapsed into a token metrics table.
Improved the sign-in and Google Cloud setup screens to use the CLI's standard styled key hints, which follow your color scheme and keybindings and drop the navigation hint when only one option is available.

title.zh-TW: Vim 常規模式解開 `?` 按鍵衝突，行內搜尋與替換指令順暢運作
title.en: Vim Normal Mode Resolves `?` Key Conflict, Restoring Inline Search and Replace Operators

body.zh-TW: 習慣在終端機開啟 Vim 鍵位的工程師，現在於輸入列進行行內定位時不再誤觸彈出視窗。過去在 Vim Normal mode（Vim 編輯器的常規命令模式）下，只要輸入框內已經包含文字，按下 `?` 鍵就會錯誤地觸發快速鍵面板跳出，導致 `f?`、`t?` 以及 `df?` 等字元搜尋與替換操作符全面失靈。現在這項按鍵攔截問題已經修復，當輸入列已有文字時，這些搜尋與替換指令都能順暢運作；只有在輸入列完全空白的待機狀態下，按下 `?` 才會如常開啟快速鍵說明。⟦彷彿在打字機上編修文件，當滾筒夾著稿紙且正在編輯時，按下特殊標點會精確執行行內字元搜尋、跳位與替換，只有在完全抽空稿紙的待機狀態下，同一個按鍵才會化身為叫出操作手冊的呼叫鈴。⟧
body.en: Engineers used to Vim keybindings in the terminal will no longer accidentally trigger popup panels during inline navigation in the prompt. Previously in Vim Normal mode, pressing `?` while the prompt already contained text incorrectly opened the shortcuts panel, breaking character-search and replace operators such as `f?`, `t?`, and `df?`. This key intercept issue is now fixed so that search and replace commands work smoothly when the prompt has text; pressing `?` only opens shortcut help when the prompt is completely empty. ⟦Like editing on a typewriter where pressing a punctuation key performs precise inline character search, jumping, and replacement while paper is loaded, and only acts as a service bell summoning the manual when the roller is completely empty.⟧

items.original: Fixed `?` in Vim Normal mode opening the shortcuts panel while the prompt already contained text, so character-search and replace operators such as `f?`, `t?`, and `df?` work; `?` still opens shortcuts on an empty prompt.

title.zh-TW: 已授權存取工作區外檔案時，讀寫跨對話產物不再跳多餘確認
title.en: Reading and Writing Cross-Conversation Artifacts No Longer Prompts for Redundant Approval When Workspace Access Is Granted

body.zh-TW: 跨對話調閱過往產出的分析文件，不必再被重複彈出的確認視窗打斷工作節奏。當使用者在對話中已經明確核准代理存取工作區以外的檔案路徑，後續若代理需要讀取或寫入另一段對話所產生的產物（artifact，獨立生成的各類文件或程式碼）檔案，過去系統仍會反覆彈出多餘的授權詢問對話框，中斷連續操作；現在這項重複提示已被徹底修復，只要先前已放行外部路徑，代理就能順暢讀寫其他對話的產物。⟦入住全包式度假村，手腕上已經配戴通行全區的識別手環，走進隔壁活動中心借閱其他房客留下的共享桌遊，櫃檯就不該要求你再次出示護照並重複簽名。⟧
body.en: Retrieving past analysis documents across conversations no longer interrupts your workflow with repeated confirmation popups. Once you explicitly allow an agent access to file paths outside your workspace, the system previously still prompted repeatedly for approval whenever the agent read or wrote artifact files created by another conversation; this redundant prompt is now fixed so the agent smoothly accesses artifacts from other conversations once external paths have been permitted. ⟦Like staying at an all-inclusive resort where wearing an all-access wristband means the front desk should not ask for your passport and signature again when you borrow board games from the recreation center next door.⟧

items.original: Fixed a redundant approval prompt when the agent reads or writes another conversation's artifact files after you have already allowed access to files outside your workspace.

entries: **Antigravity usage now appears in the interactive dashboard with consistent labels.** The dashboard and `usage report` maintain separate agent-to-loader maps, and only the report map included `antigravity`, so a detected Antigravity installation opened a dashboard tab that rendered `No data` even though the report command could load its usage. The terminal tables also lacked Antigravity's short and display names, leaving their headings as the raw lowercase agent ID. The maps had no parity check, and the first regression test hard-coded the three known agents instead of comparing the two maps, so it could not keep their keys synchronized; it now asserts exact key equality. Reported and fixed by @ClarenceKuo in #126.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 用量能顯示在互動儀表板了，表格名稱不再只留小寫代號
title.en: Antigravity usage now appears in the interactive dashboard, and table headers no longer stay as raw lowercase IDs

body.zh-TW: 你在 `usage` 查詢用量時，若裝有 Antigravity，過去切到互動儀表板只會看到 `No data` 的空白分頁。⟦這就像停車場管理處明明有登錄，出口繳費機卻自備名冊且漏記新車號，讓車主在螢幕上只查到「查無資料」，欄位也只印出底盤代號。⟧問題在於儀表板與 `usage report` 各自維護代理到載入器的對照表，先前只有報表納入 `antigravity`，即便報表指令能載入用量，偵測到安裝的儀表板分頁依然只渲染出 `No data`；終端機表格也缺少 Antigravity 的簡稱與顯示名稱，欄位標題只能留著原始小寫代理 ID。兩份對照表過去缺乏一致性檢查，最初的迴歸測試（防範舊功能被改壞的自動驗證）甚至直接寫死三款已知代理而未比對雙方清單，無法維持鍵值同步；現在測試已強制要求兩邊鍵值完全相等。
body.en: When checking usage with `usage`, if Antigravity was installed, switching to the interactive dashboard previously only showed a blank tab with `No data`. ⟦This is like a parking office having a vehicle registered, but the exit payment machine keeps its own roster and misses the new plate number, leaving the driver seeing "No data" on screen while fields only print raw chassis codes.⟧ The problem was that the dashboard and `usage report` each maintained separate agent-to-loader mapping tables. Previously, only the report included `antigravity`, so even though the report command could load usage, the dashboard tab for a detected installation still rendered `No data`. Terminal tables also lacked Antigravity's short and display names, leaving column headers stuck with the raw lowercase agent ID. The two mapping tables previously lacked consistency checks, and the initial regression tests (automated checks preventing existing features from breaking) even hard-coded three known agents instead of comparing both lists, failing to keep keys synchronized; tests now enforce exact key equality across both sides.

## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧
